MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The capacitor assortment feels like a natural addition to my breadboards and PCB components because it gives me useful options for different circuit experiments.",
    "The simple alligator clip leads fit my battery holder and relay projects by making temporary connections easier. The testing accessories also relate sensibly to that work."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Ferric chloride assumes I want to etch boards, while my existing purchases support assembling circuits with breadboards and ready-made boards.",
    "The specific taps, bulk 75-ohm resistors, and signal generator require project needs I have not identified. Being useful for some hands-on work does not make them useful for mine right now.",
    "The other lead kits are relevant, but after choosing the simple clip leads I would not buy additional kits for overlapping uses."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been taken as interest in specialized equipment and supplies for almost any electronics task.",
    "My ferrite cores and caster wheels seem to suggest more than they establish: neither means I currently need a full spool of winding wire or particular thread-cutting tools."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I am more ready to choose versatile components and simple connection supplies that work with what I already have than supplies that depend on a new specialized project.",
    "Quantity and specificity matter: an assortment gives me options, while 100 resistors of one value or a full spool of wire needs a clearer purpose.",
    "Several items can fit my interests without each becoming a purchase; choosing one lead set reduces my immediate need for the others."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my circuit-building interests but stretch them into specialized tasks and overlapping purchases I do not currently need."
}
